Engineering Continuity Lab analyzes historical engineering activity as evidence of system continuity risk. These results do not measure employee performance, expertise, organizational value, or replaceability.

Report scope and filters

Bot and generated-file filters are applied when the report is created. Generate a filtered report with:

continuity analyze --repo /path/to/repo --component-depth 2 --exclude-bots --exclude-generated > report.json
!

Git activity is only a proxy for knowledge. Scores and risk thresholds are experimental. Assess findings alongside team context.

EVIDENCE BEFORE ASSUMPTIONS
